decisions.model: direct CPO, station/time/vehicle-class specific Supercharger tariff
decisions.coverageKnown: REVE snapshot: 103 locations, 1159 EVSE, 1248 connectors. Tesla station pages expose separate pricing sections for Tesla/members and non-Tesla vehicles; exact energy price is station/time specific and is available through Tesla surfaces rather than a safe Spain-wide constant.
decisions.blockingReason: No single Spain-wide numeric direct energy tariff can be safely applied without station/time enumeration.
decisions.resumeCondition: Deterministic station tariff extraction or REVE connector-tariff mapping after first pass; keep Tesla runtime source separate from REVE pre-integration.

decisions.model: public charging operator, tariff not publicly established in first pass
decisions.coverageKnown: REVE snapshot: 14 locations, 56 EVSE/connectors. Company identity and EV-energy activity are externally corroborated, but no authoritative direct numeric tariff or deterministic public ad-hoc pricing path was located in the reasonable first-pass search.
decisions.blockingReason: Official/direct price evidence absent; deeper site-by-site investigation would violate anti-stagnation priority.
decisions.resumeCondition: New official tariff/app/QR evidence or deterministic REVE connector-tariff mapping.

decisions.coverageKnown: REVE snapshot: 2 locations, 2 EVSE/connectors. The entity is associated with an automotive dealership; no authoritative public direct charging price was found.
decisions.blockingReason: No deterministic public tariff in reasonable first pass.
decisions.resumeCondition: Official dealer/station tariff, QR price, or deterministic REVE connector mapping.

decisions.model: direct CPO station-level public price with explicit eMSP separation
decisions.coverageKnown: REVE snapshot: 258 locations, 1006 EVSE, 1013 connectors. TotalEnergies officially states that card/app direct users pay the public price shown on the charger or Charge Europe app; Charge+ and third-party eMSP pricing are separate and must not be substituted for the direct CPO price.
decisions.blockingReason: Exact numeric direct price is station/connector-level; exhaustive enumeration deferred to protect first-pass throughput.
decisions.resumeCondition: Deterministic station/app/REVE connector tariff mapping after first pass.

decisions.blockingReason: No authoritative public direct charging tariff found in reasonable first pass; entity appears primarily logistics/transport oriented.
decisions.resumeCondition: New official public access/tariff evidence or deterministic REVE connector mapping.

decisions.blockingReason: No authoritative public numeric direct charging tariff found during reasonable first pass.
decisions.resumeCondition: Official site/QR price or deterministic REVE connector mapping.

decisions.coverageKnown: REVE snapshot: 5 locations, 7 EVSE, 14 connectors. Official UMH tariff annex publishes 0.20 EUR/kWh for campus charging, with a 3 h/day limit and 1 EUR no-show reservation surcharge.
decisions.blockingReason: Exact official tariff is proven in the 2025 budget annex, but a clearly current 2026 tariff instrument was not located in this first pass; do not silently assume annual carry-over.
decisions.resumeCondition: Current 2026 UMH tariff/budget confirmation or explicit validity continuation evidence.

decisions.model: official direct CPO tariff by charging class plus optional subscription
decisions.coverageKnown: REVE snapshot: 319 locations, 1636 EVSE, 1672 connectors. Wenea officially publishes standard public prices of 0.38 EUR/kWh AC destination, 0.49 EUR/kWh DC convenience and 0.59 EUR/kWh HPC; Everyday gives 25% discount and MyStation can set one selected station at 0.25 EUR/kWh. Subscription pricing is retained separately from direct standard pricing.
decisions.resumeCondition: Map connector power/class and monitor official tariff changes; keep subscription benefits distinct from standard ad-hoc/direct price.

decisions.blockingReason: No simple authoritative direct numeric tariff or deterministic public pricing path located in reasonable first pass; deeper station enumeration deferred.
decisions.resumeCondition: New official web/app/QR evidence or deterministic REVE connector-tariff mapping.

decisions.blockingReason: Numeric price remains site/payment-path specific; no safe network-wide value.
